name: Rubble fall
notes: A roof fall packed across a tunnel (mw-e25.9, the Mooring's Watch supply tunnel). Loose stone that heavy blows and shoves bring down: blunt resisted 40%, force 20% (the knight's shield bash and heavy overhead clear it in a few blows; a mace or other blunt weapon chips it down slowly), a blade barely scratches it (95% of slash resisted) and arrows do nothing (pierce immune). Stone does not burn. Hit points come from the placement (300). Eight 0.35 m stone chunks; the fall coming down is loud, 90 dB at 1 m. Cracks telegraph it.
